source: private case-sensitive CFR 0.152 decompile; no decompiled text retained

sites.effect: New event-port peer below the live ACCESS level Monitor is closed at once; event 805 (level 4) "Access control refused event connection from /IP" is logged.
sites.cmqttd: Service::serve_event_server via admits_event_peer and peer_access_level; 805 event.

sites.effect: Load-change listener refuses peers below Monitor and logs 805.
sites.cmqttd: cmqttd provides no load-change listener; use-load-change-port is catalogue state only.

sites.effect: Config-change listener refuses peers below Monitor and logs 806.
sites.cmqttd: cmqttd provides no config-change listener; use-config-change-port is catalogue state only.

sites.effect: accept-connections-from list checked per accept; refused command peers stay connected but silent; event 806 (level 5) is logged.
sites.cmqttd: Implemented by accepts_command_peer/hold_silent (native_cgate_config_* receipts); the 806 event is not emitted. cmqttd also applies the list to its event port (deliberate tightening).

sites.effect: Session level is the highest live interface/remote row at connect; no match is level None and the native session answers 421 and logs "805 cmdN - Access control refused connection from /IP".
sites.cmqttd: connection_io 421 path now logs the numbered 805 event. Deliberate: loopback peers keep Clipsal when no row admits them, and the optional recovery token admits a LOGIN-only session.

sites.effect: An SSL peer already at Program or above is promoted to Clipsal when the last certificate in its chain carries one of two embedded vendor authority-key identifiers.
sites.cmqttd: Requires Schneider/Clipsal CA-issued certificates. cmqttd never maps certificate identities to ACCESS (deliberate; --cgate-tls-client-ca is transport admission only).

sites.effect: LOGIN and LOGOUT are dispatched without checkRunCommand, so they work at None.
sites.cmqttd: session_auth runs before handler floors.

sites.effect: LOGIN searches every row with an internal Max context; exact-case username and password; 422 on no match, 400 without a password; success installs a new AccessContext at the row level, even above the interface level or at None.
sites.cmqttd: session_auth; one-word LOGIN now returns 400 when no recovery token is configured.

sites.effect: LOGOUT re-reads the live ACCESS table for the socket; existing sessions keep their level until then.
sites.cmqttd: session_auth LOGOUT uses connection_access_level.

sites.effect: ACCESS LIST shows, and ACCESS DELETE numbers, only rows at or below the session level.
sites.cmqttd: Service::access LIST/DELETE filter entry.level() <= level.

sites.effect: Row address octet 255 is a wildcard; only the first four address bytes are compared (IPv6 truncated).
sites.cmqttd: IPv4 wildcard implemented in access::address_matches; IPv6 compares whole addresses (deliberate; native truncation not captured).

sites.effect: Level is the maximum of matching interface/remote rows; a row whose name no longer resolves throws and the caller falls back to level 0 for every peer.
sites.cmqttd: Maximum implemented by peer_access_level; cmqttd rejects unresolved names at ACCESS ADD rather than failing every later admission (deliberate).

sites.effect: Command event 761 and response events 766 are logged only for top-level commands whose floor is Debug or lower; ACCESS, LOG, PP, SAVE_TO_NVM and START_BACKGROUND_JOB leave no trace.
sites.cmqttd: native_hides_command_trace in publish_command_entry/publish_command_responses.

sites.effect: LOGIN is logged as "Command: LOGIN [arguments hidden]"; LOGOUT as "Command: LOGOUT".
sites.cmqttd: cmqttd keeps its established "<redacted command>" and "<redacted>" response text.

sites.effect: HELP <command> below the command floor answers a syntax error instead of help or 420.
sites.cmqttd: Not compared; cmqttd family help applies the handler floor and answers 420.

sites.effect: Family commands call a leaf runCommand directly, so a leaf accessControl is not re-checked; only the family floor and explicit enforceAccess calls apply.
sites.cmqttd: cmqttd enforces the per-path floors observed on the original, which include this effect.

sites.effect: Each DALI session plan step re-checks its Program-level command against the AccessContext retained when the plan started; a later LOGIN swap does not affect it.
sites.cmqttd: Redundant with the Program DALI entry floors enforced before a plan starts.

sites.effect: DALI plan reset step re-check, as above.
sites.cmqttd: As dali-plan-step-recheck.

sites.effect: Per-line and per-ECG DALI sub-command re-checks with the retained context.
sites.cmqttd: As dali-plan-step-recheck.

sites.effect: An injected DALI response step re-checks the retained context and throws CBusCommandException.
sites.cmqttd: As dali-plan-step-recheck.

sites.effect: PROGRAMMER ADD_INSTRUCTION re-checks the instruction class (base lk declares Clipsal; DALI sub-command classes Program). The obfuscated AddInstType constants make every named instruction type fail parse first in build 2001, so the Clipsal branch is unreachable.
sites.cmqttd: Unreachable natively; cmqttd keeps the observed PROGRAMMER Program entry floor.

sites.effect: LOCK owner is a weak reference to the session AccessContext; LOGIN/LOGOUT replace the context, so its locks release when the collector clears it; relocking is never idempotent.
sites.cmqttd: release_advisory_locks on LOGIN/LOGOUT (deterministic; native release timing varies).

sites.effect: GET/SHOW of an exposed parameter below its read level answers "420 Access denied: <object> (Insufficient access level for read)".
sites.cmqttd: service::object_access applies object_access_table before GET dispatch; <object> is the path as sent.

sites.effect: SET below the parameter write level answers "420 Access denied: <object> (Insufficient access level for write)".
sites.cmqttd: service::object_access applies object_access_table before SET dispatch or PCI I/O.

sites.effect: DO/ON/OFF/RAMP/TERMINATERAMP of an exposed method below its level answers 420 "(Insufficient access level to run method)".
sites.cmqttd: service::object_access applies object_access_table before DO dispatch; ON/OFF/RAMP keep the Operate handler floor, equal to every group method level.

sites.effect: Project start/default-project operations run with an internal Admin context.
sites.cmqttd: cmqttd has no internal command scripts; project startup is not ACCESS-gated.

sites.effect: Startup command files run with an internal Admin context.
sites.cmqttd: cmqttd runs no startup command files.

sites.effect: The local console session runs at Program.
sites.cmqttd: cmqttd has no interactive console.
